emotions.meaning: Upbeat commercial voice for promotions and offers.
emotions.speaker_intent: To excite the audience and push them to act (visit, buy, message).
emotions.rate: brisk, but price and offer said clearly
emotions.pauses: a beat before the offer or price, a beat after the call to action
emotions.breath: energized, quick catch-breaths
emotions.emphasis: on product name, price, discount and deadline
emotions.thai_note: Promo Thai uses วันนี้เท่านั้น / ลดพิเศษ / รีบเลย / ทักมาเลย and particles นะคะ / เลยครับ / จ้า. Numbers and prices must keep their exact lexical tones (สาม vs. สาม-ร้อย) so they are not misheard; excitement is in level, range and energy.
examples_th: แว่นกรองแสงสีฟ้า ลดพิเศษวันนี้เท่านั้นนะคะ ทักมาเลยค่ะ!
ตรวจสายตาฟรี พร้อมกรอบแว่นสวยๆ ให้เลือกเพียบเลยครับ แวะมาได้ทุกวัน
examples_en: Free eye test with every frame, this week only!
variants: Hype market caller.
Friendly shop owner.
Upscale cool: lower, smoother.
Fast radio-ad read.
ai_mistakes: Shouting.
Flat reading of an offer.
Stress on the wrong word, burying the price.
Robotic fake cheer.
emotions.gemini_style: an upbeat, friendly shop promo voice, bright and energetic, clear on the price
emotions.evidence_note: Craft only.

emotions.name_th: ผู้เชี่ยวชาญน่าเชื่อถือ
emotions.meaning: Calm authoritative explaining voice for eye-health facts and product advice.
emotions.speaker_intent: To inform clearly and earn the listener's trust.
emotions.pitch_range: moderate, confident falls at phrase ends
emotions.pauses: after key facts and numbers so they sink in
emotions.breath: even, inaudible
emotions.emphasis: on facts, numbers and the recommended action
emotions.thai_note: Clear articulation, polite ครับ / ค่ะ, calm falling phrases; avoid rising question tails that sound unsure. Medical words (ต้อเนื้อ, ค่าสายตา) must keep their lexical tones exactly; authority comes from steady level and rate.
examples_th: ค่าสายตาเปลี่ยนได้ทุกปีครับ ควรตรวจอย่างน้อยปีละครั้ง
แสงแดดเป็นสาเหตุหนึ่งของต้อเนื้อค่ะ แว่นกันแดดที่กัน UV ช่วยได้มาก
examples_en: Your prescription can change every year, so get checked at least once a year.
variants: Doctor: calm, kind.
Teacher: clear, structured.
Documentary narrator.
Friendly specialist: warmer, more casual.
ai_mistakes: Salesy hype.
Monotone lecture.
Uncertain rising ends.
Rushed facts.
emotions.gemini_style: a calm, trusted optometrist explaining clearly and confidently
emotions.evidence_note: Craft only.

emotions.name_th: แสดงความเสียใจอย่างเป็นทางการ
emotions.meaning: Respectful formal sympathy for a death or loss, e.g. a shop notice or a public statement.
emotions.speaker_intent: To honor the deceased and respect the family with dignity.
emotions.pauses: measured pauses between clauses; pause before the name
emotions.voice_quality: soft but clear, controlled; no tears
emotions.breath: even, calm
emotions.emphasis: gentle weight on the name and the condolence phrase
emotions.thai_note: Formal Thai: ขอแสดงความเสียใจ / ขอไว้อาลัย / ขอให้ดวงวิญญาณไปสู่สุคติ, with polite ครับ / ค่ะ. Formality comes from slow rate, lower level and restrained voice; lexical tones stay exact (especially in names and royal-style formal words).
examples_th: ทางร้านขอแสดงความเสียใจกับครอบครัวของคุณยายจันทร์ด้วยครับ
ขอให้ดวงวิญญาณของคุณตาไปสู่สุคตินะคะ
examples_en: We extend our deepest condolences to the family.
variants: Official statement.
Personal but formal.
Shop notice read.
Ceremony address.
ai_mistakes: Over-emotional crying.
Cheerful announcer tone.
Too fast.
Robotic, cold.
emotions.gemini_style: a respectful formal condolence, slow, soft and dignified
emotions.evidence_note: Craft only.

emotions.name_th: เฉยเมย ไม่แคร์
emotions.meaning: Not caring about the topic or the person; disengaged, sometimes as a deliberate snub.
emotions.speaker_intent: To signal lack of interest or end the conversation.
emotions.rate: slow drawl or short clipped answers
emotions.pauses: few; or a dismissive gap before answering
emotions.breath: bored sigh
emotions.emphasis: none
emotions.thai_note: Thai: ก็แล้วแต่ / ไม่รู้สิ / เออ / อะไรก็ได้ with flat, dropped or minimal particles. Indifference comes from low level, narrow range and lack of energy; lexical tones of words remain intact.
examples_th: เออ... แล้วแต่เลย จะกรอบไหนก็ได้
ไม่รู้สิคะ ไม่ได้สนใจเรื่องแว่นเท่าไหร่
examples_en: Whatever. Any frame's fine.
variants: Bored teenager.
Cold snub.
Tired after a long day.
Dismissive boss.
ai_mistakes: Sounds angry.
Sounds sad.
Too expressive.
Too polite and engaged.
emotions.gemini_style: bored and indifferent, flat and low, not caring at all
emotions.evidence_note: Boredom tendencies (low F0, narrow range, slow) in acted speech are an analogy; indifference itself is craft.
